description: Live per-execution accounting over IPFIX: factd follows the collector's stream during the run and exports per-execution records (connections, established, failed, destinations, bytes sent and received; executionId information element) as IPFIX over UDP; tshark captures them, and the capture is decoded with Wireshark's IPFIX dissector and compared with factd's records and with the independent reference (connections per execution by destination port; bytes per execution from the destination's per-request log). Tools: async (new connection per call) and httpx_shared (keep-alive pool shared by sessions, send binding on). Collector fact-bytes.bt.
